metadata.name: sheetio.save
metadata.description: ({ seg, fmt }) - serialize a worksheet segment to bytes. fmt in {csv, xlsx, 甲}: CSV/XLSX are values-only, .甲 is the rich plastron archive (cels + formulas round-trip). Writes the bytes to OPFS (/<seg>.<ext>, best-effort) and returns { bytes, filename, text? } so the host can offer a download. xlsx reuses the xlsx segment's exporter.

metadata.name: sheetio.open
metadata.description: ({ bytes, name }) - detect the format by the name's extension (csv/xlsx/甲), build a worksheet cels record, materialize it as a NEW standalone sheet window, and return the new segment name. .甲 restores cels + formulas; csv/xlsx import values.
